Praxe nebo vzdělání v oblasti mezd či v personalistice je nesmírnou výhodou. Pokud jsi však čerstvý absolvent/ka a o tuto oblast se aktivně zajímáš, určitě si budeme rozumět; Chceš se raději dále rozvíjet, než ustrnout na jednom místě; Máš znalost anglického jazyka minimálně na úrovni B1 (ústní a písemnou formou); Balíček Microsoft Office pro tebe není neznámý pojem, zvlášte excel je tvůj kamarád; Disponuješ smyslem pro detail, schopností rychle reagovat a prioritizovat; Co Vám můžeme nabídnout Balíček benefitů – extra dny dovolené , 13. plat , bonusy, stravenky, měsíční příspěvek na kartu Pluxee Flexi pro volnočasové aktivity, karta Multisport, sick days, výuka angličtiny v pracovní době, rozpočet na teambuildingy a vzdělávání, týdenní lekce jógy v kanceláři, firemní akce a večírky pro týmy i celou společnost (bowling, paintball, letní grilování na střeše apod.); Bonus za setrvání ve společnosti a doporučení kandidáta; Flexibilní pracovní doba a práce z domova (3 dny v týdnu); Pracovní smlouva na plný úvazek na dobu neurčitou ; Zakládáme si na silné kultuře zpětné vazby, o feedback můžete požádat kdykoliv; Kariérní růst : svou kariéru můžete rozvíjet prostřednictvím interních příležitostí v rámci TMF; Každý den na vás v kanceláři čeká káva, čaj, čerstvé ovoce a nanuky; Nabízíme bezplatné online vzdělávání v rámci naší oblíbené TMF Business Academy , kde si můžete vybrat z široké nabídky kurzů; Nabízíme práci v mezinárodním prostředí se zajímavým portfoliem klientů ; Můžete se spolehnout na podporu kolegů a vstřícný přístup manažera; Nabízíme také bezplatné online vzdělávání prostřednictvím interaktivního jazykového portálu GoFluent . review_candidates.job_function: Project Management, Information Technology, and Consulting
review_candidates.description: Would you like to work for an independent consultancy alongside experienced colleagues, where a relaxed atmosphere is combined with commitment, professionalism, and a sustainable work–life balance? Midagon is a Nordic, independent management and IT consultancy specialising in leading complex transformation projects and programmes. We are now looking for an ERP Project or Programme Manager to take on assignments for both national and international clients. You will be based at one of our offices in Stockholm or Örebro, and we offer a hybrid working model. Naturally, some days will be spent on-site with clients. The Role You will lead complex transformation projects in close collaboration with our own or the client’s project managers and business developers. You support the client throughout the entire change journey – from early project initiation and pre study through to implementation and handover. With your expertise, you act as an independent advisor, helping the client achieve their business objectives and prepare for future challenges. At Midagon, you will join a team of senior consultants with deep ERP expertise across areas such as manufacturing, supply chain and finance. The team brings broad experience from various roles and system vendors, with collaboration and knowledge sharing as core elements of how we work. We are looking for someone who: Has many years of consulting experience within ERP transformations Has led business and IT transformation projects within ERP programmes, M&A, enterprise architecture, or industrial digitalisation Has strong knowledge of one or preferably several leading ERP systems such as SAP, M3, IFS or Microsoft Dynamics Has an interest in AI Communicates fluently in both Swedish and English To thrive with us, you combine enthusiasm and pragmatism with a structured and methodical approach. Experience in both leadership and project management is essential, as are strong skills in change management. What We Offer Our ERP business is growing, and you will have the opportunity to be part of this journey and further strengthen collaboration with our Finnish colleagues. You will work on assignments that truly develop you – together with engaged and experienced colleagues who are passionate about creating value in complex transformation environments. You will be part of a senior consulting team where professionalism, collaboration and quality are a natural part of everyday life. We work with digital transformations within business development, project and programme management, and various specialist areas. Assignments are varied and challenging, and you will have significant scope to influence both delivery and ways of working. Our culture is characterised by low hierarchy, engagement, and a sustainable balance between work and private life. Here, you will have freedom, trust, and colleagues who are always willing to share their expertise. Curious to know more? Submit your application via the link below. If you have any questions about the role, please contact the responsible recruiter Jonna Rickard Lindberg, People Manager, at jonna.rickardlindberg@midagon.com. We look forward to receiving your application! About Midagon Midagon Group is one of the leading independent business and IT transformation companies in the Nordics, with over 200 consultants in Espoo, Örebro and Stockholm. Midagon aims to be the industry leader in transformation, the most client-oriented consulting company and the best place to work for experienced consultants. Our company values - client success, together and quality of life - are visible and lived up to every day. Midagon’s culture is shaped by its ways of working, extensive experience, pragmatic attitude, humour, courage, and respect for others.
